prefix_policy.historical_request_reuse: none: native recomputes each request, vLLM endpoint generates fresh cache salt

graph_policy: native optional graphs enabled; vLLM default compile/graph
candidate_must_win: All predefined cells: lower pooled P50/P95, higher QPS; no failed or skipped requests. Screen cannot accept a change.

diagnostic_plan.purpose: Diagnostic only; instrumented frozen068 Rust+CUDA, toggle only exact request-local prefix
diagnostic_plan.schedule: Full Public C1 3 rounds as warm history; short-only C1/C8/C16/C32 each3; original and shuffle11 C16 each3
diagnostic_plan.prediction: If exclusive prefix/compaction prevents concurrency scaling, disabling it should increase cross-request batching and reduce short-only C16 queue time, even if C1 execution becomes slower. Long/mixed regression is allowed diagnostic evidence, never acceptance.
diagnostic_plan.controls: same binary/weights/GPU/graph/protocol/content, no cached responses; instrumentation means diagnostic not formal performance acceptance
